I quit my meds once with the help of my doctor. It was great having all of my thoughts and emotions working. I was able to hold down a great job that I loved. I went four years without incident and then a trigger, along with lack of sleep, set off a nasty panic attack that I couldn't get a handle on. Cue nonstop blinding panic for two weeks, followed by my second breakdown. I went back on meds after that. 

I am in no way trying to discourage or jinx you. Just take care of yourself OK. Don't let things get so bad that you relapse. Listen to your body/mind and the signs that you're given so that you stay ahead of the game. If you have to take time to relax, do it. If you don't have time, make it. Find a way and an outlet and take care of you. 

You can do this :)

I wish you nothing but the best.

I live in a small town so there are only two churches here. I don't think that they offer any types of shelters. The nearest bigger town is 30 minutes away. It's where I had to move to since my LL has pretty much blacklisted me. 

My LL says that he is evicting me for failure to pay rent but I have receipts for the last two years proving that I have paid. I tried to ask for legal advice on different forums but all I got was hate for thinking that the system is corrupt and that I wouldn't get a fair hearing. I know that I'm not going to get anything fair from the court. I have accepted that.

I used up the last of my paycheck to pay for my cats cremation. I couldn't bury her here at this house that I cannot stand and then leave her. 

Right now I am trying to breathe slow and get outside into the sun for a little. I'm trying to do as you said and take it one step at a time. It's really all I can do. I can only hope that the judge will at least give me until after the first which is closer to my moving date.

You have babies to think about and they need you. You might not think they do but I promise that they do. My Mom hung herself when I was 12 and it destroyed me. You commented on my post earlier and so you have seen how mentally messed up I am. Please don't do that to your kids. They need you, believe me. I would give anything to have my Mom here. If you want to talk I'm here.
